newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - FRANCE - LE MONDE JUNE 2.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - FRANCE - LE MONDE JUNE 2.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- President Jacques Chirac naming Socialist party leader Lionel Jospin Prime Minister on Monday, after the left won a majority in Sunday's parliamentary election runoff.
-- Failed gamble of early election opens up a crisis in the centre-right, with Chirac's Gaullist RPR party the main loser.

-- The French expect the left to fight unemployment and reform politics, but have few illusions on the impact of the election on their daily life, according to a survey by Sofres for Le Monde and TF1 television.
-- French small and medium-sized independent pharmaceutical laboratories confident in their future.
